note: Reviewer classification of source_findings.json. PROVEN_* means the defect follows from the cell text/formula itself relative to its own headings; it is still not evidence of a submitted amount. Other kinds require an owner policy decision or a missing definition.

kinds.PROVEN_FORMULA_DEFECT: Formula references contradict the sheet's own headings (double counting, wrong row/column).
kinds.PROVEN_LOGIC_DEFECT: Predicate text is internally inconsistent (direction, overlap, gaps) relative to its own headings.
kinds.POLICY_MISMATCH: Legacy rule differs from the owner's stated policy; not a proven historical numerical error.
kinds.POLICY_CONFLICT: Legacy selectors can overlap or contradict; precedence/partition required.
kinds.MISSING_DEFINITION: A required metric, balance or identifier has no authoritative definition.
kinds.CROSSWALK_REQUIRED: Legacy Ethix selector needs an approved T24 field/product crosswalk.
kinds.CALCULATION_BASIS_AMBIGUITY: Stock versus movement or other amount basis is ambiguous.
kinds.MISSING_FEED: Requires an external feed whose schema is not supplied.
kinds.MISSING_MAPPING: A report/section has no target mapping.
kinds.STRUCTURE: Source structure fact (layout, aliases, repeated blocks) that affects joins.
